Please read LICENSE and LICENSING.md first. This public request does not
grant permission; commercial use needs a separate written agreement from
the project licensor. Do not include private contractual or personal details.

## Intended use

Describe the product, service, paid work, business display, or monetization.

## Project scope

Tool/version, original or modified code, hosting/distribution, and expected
devices/users. Mention any third-party assets/services involved.

## Requested permission

Describe the scope and intended duration. The repository owner can follow
up to arrange a written agreement.
